jobs.title: Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**Onboarding Specialist**

*Guiding Merchants from Sales Close to Go-Live*

**Full-Time | Fenton, MO or Remote**

FLEX Payment Solutions is seeking an organized, highly motivated, and detail-oriented Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This is a newly created position — a chance to help build, develop, and improve our onboarding processes as the role evolves.

You'll report to our Director of Compliance (a reporting structure that may change as the Compliance team grows), and you can work from our Fenton, MO office or remotely.

**About the Role**
------------------

You'll guide each new Merchant through onboarding — from Sales close, through completing the FLEX application, to full approval and activation. You'll be the Merchant's primary point of contact for applications and documentation, make sure every file is complete and accurate before it goes to Underwriting, and keep our Sales team informed of progress through Hub Tracker. (This role is not responsible for negotiating Merchant fee schedules.)

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Set expectations —** explain the application process and why each piece of documentation matters.
* **Collect and review —** coordinate Merchant documentation and review every application for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before Underwriting.
* **Solve problems —** work with Merchants, Underwriting, and Sponsor Banks to resolve questions and documentation issues.
* **Keep everyone in the loop —** monitor applications, communicate status, and provide daily updates to Sales, Risk, and Management.
* **Manage the pipeline —** own open pre-Underwriting tickets in FLEX CRM and track key metrics like Time-to-Approved and Time-to-Live.
* **Make it better —** spot trends and bottlenecks, then design and implement new onboarding processes with our internal teams.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3+ years of experience in Merchant onboarding, implementation, project management, payments, or fintech
* Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal teams and Merchants
* Comfort working in a CRM environment
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to juggle multiple applications and priorities
* Independence and ownership — you're comfortable building processes in a newly created role
* An eye for process improvement and the ability to use data and reporting to drive change

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in the payments or fintech industry
* Working knowledge of ACH, Merchant Processing, Pay-by-Bank, and RTP
* IRIS CRM experience

**How Success Will Be Measured**
--------------------------------

Success is measured through both your individual performance and improvements to the overall onboarding process, including:

* Time from file submission to Risk through approval and go-live
* Percentage of files accepted by Risk on the first submission
* Merchant activation rate — the percentage of Merchants processing within an established period after go-live
* Reduction in incomplete or inaccurate application submissions
* Process improvements successfully implemented and adopted by the team
* Effective communication and coordination between Sales, Risk, Underwriting, Sponsor Banks, and Merchants

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* Discretionary bonus opportunities
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental, Medical, Vision, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a 3% company contribution, plus optional employee contributions
* Paid Time Off
* 10 paid holidays, plus an additional paid day for your birthday
* Employee Assistance Program
* Cell phone allowance

**About FLEX Payment Solutions**
--------------------------------

FLEX Payment Solutions is a Financial Technology industry leader providing electronic payment processing solutions through an exclusive network of banking partners and innovative in-house technologies. Headquartered in the St. Louis, MO area, FLEX began offering electronic payment processing solutions to businesses in February 2017. Since then, FLEX has processed $5B in total payments and has been honored as an Inc. 5000 list member for five consecutive years (2021–2025). To learn more, visit www.flexpaymentsolutions.com.

*If you take pride in getting details right and helping new Merchants get up and running, we'd love to hear from you!*

Balto builds AI for contact centers. We help agents in the moment, score every call so leaders don’t have to, and show teams what their customers are really saying, all in one place.

***Full-Time, Remote, U.S. Only***

**About the role**

As a Senior Implementation Manager, you’ll lead complex customer implementations from kickoff through go-live. You’ll bring together executives, business owners, IT teams, and Balto partners around the outcomes customers want to achieve, while ensuring the technology is configured effectively.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can move confidently between business priorities, technical decisions, and hands-on project execution.

* Customer outcomes: align stakeholders on clear goals, success criteria, priorities, and decisions.
* Technical delivery: guide integrations, manage risks, and keep executive sponsors informed.

* Bring clarity and direction to complex, multi-stakeholder customer projects
* Move comfortably between executive-level business conversations and technical discussions with IT
* Anticipate risks, manage competing priorities, and drive projects forward with ownership
* Build trust across Customer Success, Sales, Support, Engineering, and customer teams

* Share effective approaches and technical knowledge that strengthen the implementation team

* Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, reduce deployment timelines, and strengthen the overall customer experience.
* Provide technical guidance and share best practices with other Implementation Managers to strengthen team capabilities.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must-haves**

* Substantial experience independently leading complex, customer-facing software implementations or solutions engagements
* Demonstrated success aligning executive, business, and technical stakeholders around customer outcomes
* Excellent project management, prioritization, risk management, and multi-project execution skills
* Confident executive communication and the ability to translate between technical and business topics

Environmental Solutions
  
Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.
  
  
Sustainability Innovation
  
Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.
  
  
The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. **Remote**

**Company Overview:** AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. The Implementation Specialist leads implementation projects from requirements gathering, workflow assessments, and project planning through implementation, training, go-live support and transfer to end-user support. Project types vary and may include onboarding/offboarding Ambulatory Surgery Centers (ASC) and anesthesia entities. The Implementation Specialist documents findings for each project and provides clear, concise written recommendations. The Implementation Specialist is responsible for a variety of tasks required to successfully, manage, coordinate and lead implementation projects including performing system builds, creating user documentation and conducting end-user training for ASC, Central Billing Office (CBO) and corporate users.   + Rapidly deployable, repeatable processes
  + Successful revenue cycle management with demonstrable revenue stream from ERA processes within 20 days of go-live date
  + Cost-effective follow-up and phased training approach for implementing post- or complimentary EPM go-live features such as Document Scanning, Real Time Server, Background Business Processor, Worklog/Tasking, other ancillary products and iterative version updates

* Assess current configuration and develop customized modifications to meet specific needs of centers, the Central Billing Office (CBO) or anesthesia entities.
* Troubleshoot NextGen configuration and specification issues with associated vendors and payers.
* Participate in implementation project related integrations as a subject matter expert; perform system testing and troubleshoot interface issues with associated vendors as needed.
* Assist EDI Specialists with payer or claim related issues.
* Assess complex workflows within the ASC affiliated environments to ensure the optimal configuration of the NextGen system and any other vendor products such as Endoscopy Report writing systems, laboratory systems, etc.
* Facilitate meetings, demonstrations and training with center staff on the NextGen application.
* Conduct training sessions in small and large groups in various settings (both onsite and remote) with minimal equipment, as the situation requires.
* Conduct performance reviews for existing centers and practices to assist Operations teams in finding opportunities to enhance efficiency.
* Collaborate with various vendors for issue resolution.
* Evaluate existing centers’ configurations and revise to meet upgrades and new regulatory requirements as needed utilizing technology and efficient methods of advanced functionalities made available within the upgrades.
* Demonstrate ability to relate with full spectrum of personnel in the ASC and/or practice environment from front desk receptionist to billing specialist to clinical and provider personnel.
* Communicate issues to AMSURG staff and Operations teams concisely and discuss solution options effectively as part of a patient-centered and action-oriented team.
* Create and update professional training materials, guides, and curricula.
* Monitor the Background Business Processor as needed.

* Adhere to all company policies and procedures, including Information Security Policies and ensure that AMSURG remains as secure as possible
* Regular and reliable attendance required
* Other duties as assigned.

  + At least two (2) years direct use experience with NextGen Practice Management version 5.8 and higher.
  + Thorough understanding of revenue cycle workflows in ambulatory surgery center and/or medical practice is required.

Benefits offered include but are not limited to: Paid Time Off, Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Healthcare FSA, Dependent Care FSA, Limited Healthcare FSA, FSAs for Transportation and Parking & HSAs, and a matching 401(K) Plan.

**Paid Time Off:**

jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Onboarding Manager is the primary point of contact and strategic driver for every hospital going live on Instinct. You are the project lead, the workflow expert, and the trusted advisor all in one — responsible for keeping implementations on track, on time, and on scope while earning the confidence of hospital leadership throughout the process.

This is not a task-management role. You bring executive presence, a strong sense of urgency, and the consultative skill to navigate a hospital's operational complexity while holding them accountable to the milestones that matter. You know that a delayed go-live is a delayed relationship, and you take that seriously.

You own end-to-end project coordination — from kick-off to go-live — working closely with Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, integrations, and internal teams to deliver a seamless, high-quality experience. Your strength is your ability to make every hospital feel like their implementation is the most important project you are running — even when you are managing several simultaneously

**What You'll Do ️**

**Project Leadership & Management**

* Project Ownership: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned onboarding projects from signed contract through go-live and handoff to the active CS team.
* Timeline Management: Build, manage, and enforce project plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and accountability — targeting go-live within the 8-week SLA.
* Risk & Escalation: Identify project risks proactively and escalate effectively — to the hospital, to the Team Lead, and across internal teams — so nothing sits quietly off track.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Coordinate across Implementation Specialists, Training Specialists, Integration partners, and Medical Review to keep all workstreams moving in sync.

**Customer Relationship & Consultative Approach**

* Trusted Advisor: Position yourself as a knowledgeable, credible partner throughout the project — not just a task tracker. Help hospital leaders see the full picture of what a successful go-live enables for their team.
* Executive Presence: Communicate confidently and credibly with practice owners, medical directors, and hospital administrators — matching your communication style to the audience while maintaining clarity and urgency.
* Workflow Development: Lead workflow discovery and design sessions with the hospital, translating their current clinical and operational processes into Instinct-configured workflows that fit how their team actually works.
* Sense of Urgency: Keep the hospital engaged and moving — because a delayed implementation is always a risk to go-live. You are skilled at creating accountability without creating friction.

**Technical & Product Coordination**

* Integration Setup: Own the coordination of integrations — including lab, imaging, and pharmacy partners — ensuring technical readiness aligns with the project timeline.
* Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Instinct's product capabilities and configuration options, serving as the go-to resource for workflow questions during onboarding.
* Training Coordination: Coordinate with Training Specialists to ensure training is scoped, scheduled, and delivered at the right point in the project — reinforcing adoption ahead of go-live.

**Who You Are ‍**

**Must Haves:**

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. Direct experience working in or closely with veterinary hospitals — clinical, operational, or administrative.
* **Project Management Experience:** 2–4+ years managing customer-facing implementation or onboarding projects, ideally in SaaS or health technology.
* **Instinct Software Familiarity:** Strongly preferred. Existing knowledge of Instinct's configuration and workflow capabilities accelerates ramp significantly.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated ability to manage relationships across multiple levels of a customer organization, including executives.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable coordinating software integrations, data requirements, and configuration discussions — even without deep technical expertise.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $65,000 - $80,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

*Instinct is an equal opportunity employer committed to equality and providing a pleasant work environment free from harassment or discrimination in any form. All employees will be treated equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, ancestry, veteran, or disability status.*

*If you require accommodations throughout any part of the pre-employment process, please contact our recruiting team at* *recruiting@instinct.vet*

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end behavioral health application build, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and go-live support across outpatient, crisis, residential, inpatient, and Substance Use Disorder (SUD) programs.

* Design, build, and maintain Epic Behavioral Health workflows and clinical documentation.
* Configure Epic navigators, SmartForms, flowsheets, note templates, and SmartTexts.
* Develop assessments, treatment plans, episodes, and facility structures.
* Configure orders and referral preference lists.
* Support consent management and compliance with 42 CFR Part 2 requirements.
* Translate clinical and operational requirements into Epic application configurations.
* Develop and execute test scripts, identify defects, and coordinate issue resolution.
* Troubleshoot production issues and resolve application support tickets.
* Maintain build documentation, trackers, and Sherlock records.
* Present application builds during stakeholder workgroups.

* Current **Epic ClinDoc and Ambulatory certifications** (Mandatory).
* Behavioral Health accreditation or certification preferred.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience as an Epic Application Analyst.
* At least 2 years of hands-on Epic Behavioral Health build experience.
* Experience with at least two full-cycle Epic implementations and completed go-lives.
* Strong experience with clinical documentation, including:
* Navigators
* SmartForms
* Flowsheets
* Note Templates
* SmartTexts
* Preference Lists
* Experience supporting behavioral health workflows across outpatient, crisis, residential, inpatient, or SUD settings.
* Strong testing, troubleshooting, and production support experience.
* Ability to work independently and manage assigned priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with county or public-sector behavioral health organizations.
* Knowledge of 42 CFR Part 2 and behavioral health regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with California Medi-Cal behavioral health documentation and billing.
* Experience supporting clinical stakeholders, quality management teams, and healthcare leadership.
